name: Global Master Data Wiring — All Form Pages

content.description: Wire all 36 remaining form pages across 13 modules to use master data lookups instead of plain text inputs. Create a centralized lookups module at src/lib/lookups.ts with 8 query functions. Update each form page to fetch options server-side and pass to form components as select dropdowns.
capabilities: Centralized src/lib/lookups.ts with 8 lookup functions (ports, customers, vessels, container types, commodities, terminals, currencies, countries)
All port fields across all modules render as select dropdowns from mdm_ports
All customer/counterparty fields render as select dropdowns from mdm_customers
All vessel fields render as select dropdowns from mdm_vessels
All container type fields render as select dropdowns from mdm_container_types
All currency fields render as select dropdowns from hardcoded ISO 4217 list
All country fields render as select dropdowns from hardcoded ISO 3166 list
Commodity/HS code fields render as select dropdowns from mdm_commodities
Terminal/depot fields render as select dropdowns from mdm_terminals
acceptance_criteria: src/lib/lookups.ts exports 8 functions: getPortOptions, getCustomerOptions, getVesselOptions, getContainerTypeOptions, getCommodityOptions, getTerminalOptions, getCurrencyOptions, getCountryOptions
All 36 form pages import and use appropriate lookup functions
All port fields (20+ occurrences) are type:'select' with DB-sourced options
All customer/counterparty fields (15+ occurrences) are type:'select' with DB-sourced options
All vessel fields (12+ occurrences) are type:'select' with DB-sourced options
All currency fields (20+ occurrences) are type:'select' with hardcoded ISO list
Edit forms pre-select the existing value correctly
Cargo type, status, priority fields remain hardcoded (business logic, not master data)
Existing validation schemas updated to accept DB values (relax hardcoded enums where needed)
edge_cases: Master data table empty for a tenant — dropdown shows only 'Select...' placeholder
Existing record has value no longer in master data — edit form shows blank selection (user must re-select)
Multiple tenants — each sees only their own master data
Deleted master data (soft delete) — excluded from options via isNull(deletedAt) filter
Large master data sets (100+ ports) — capped at 50 results, ordered alphabetically
error_handling: DB query failure in lookup — Next.js error boundary catches and shows error page
Form submission with value not in current lookup list — API validation accepts (loose validation on reference fields)
